newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 33.186 (33.266).
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 33.186 (33.266).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixed the crown at 33.186 to the dollar after Thursday's fixing at 33.266 and at 19.629 to the mark from 19.696.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.0 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated at 11:30:00 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of -0.76 percent, after Thursday's -1.06 percent.
At the time of the calculation, the crown was trading on the interbank market at -0.76 versus the basket.
